originalAlarm.description: Potential leak of memory pointed to by '__ptr_13'

sanitizedDescription: Potential leak of memory pointed to by 'ptr'
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 6e2b75740be.c (Linux module). 'Potential leak of memory pointed to by ptr' at line 39 ('ptr = malloc(512)'). 'ptr' is assigned to 'module_core(mod)' at line 43, which stores the pointer in the module struct. The pointer is properly freed via 'free(module_core(mod))' at line 60 (when CONFIG_MODULE_UNLOAD=true) or via 'free(hdr)' at line 67 which encompasses the module memory. The analyzer cannot track that ptr is stored in the module struct and freed through that alias. This is an alias tracking limitation — not a true memory leak. The memory is intentionally retained in the module struct until explicit cleanup.
